capabilities.label: Connect
capabilities.summary: How the factory signs in to the forge.

forgejo.note: A bot account's access token in the tenant vault stands in for an App installation.

ghes.note: A GitHub App you register on the instance; its App id and private key are kept in the tenant vault.

gitea.note: A bot account's access token in the tenant vault stands in for an App installation.

gitlab.note: A bot user's, group's or project's access token in the tenant vault stands in for an App installation.

capabilities.label: Webhooks
capabilities.summary: Events reach the factory as they happen; nothing is polled while webhooks arrive.

forgejo.note: Repository or organisation webhooks the factory creates with the connection's secret, signed with X-Gitea-Signature or X-Forgejo-Signature.

gitea.note: Repository or organisation webhooks the factory creates with the connection's secret, signed with X-Gitea-Signature or X-Forgejo-Signature.

gitlab.note: Project or group webhooks the factory creates with the connection's secret token (X-Gitlab-Token).

capabilities.label: Repository discovery
capabilities.summary: The repositories the connection can reach are listed for Repositories and managed scope.

forgejo.note: The organisation's or the bot user's repositories, refreshed every 6 hours and on Refresh.

gitea.note: The organisation's or the bot user's repositories, refreshed every 6 hours and on Refresh.

gitlab.note: The group's projects including subgroups, or the bot's memberships, refreshed every 6 hours and on Refresh.

capabilities.label: Open pull requests
capabilities.summary: The draft_pr output and Belai crews open pull requests from factory branches.

gitlab.note: A merge request; its number is the merge request's iid.

capabilities.label: Draft and ready
capabilities.summary: A pull request is opened as a draft and marked ready at a checkpoint.

forgejo.note: The WIP: title prefix, which Gitea and Forgejo treat as work in progress and refuse to merge.

gitea.note: The WIP: title prefix, which Gitea and Forgejo treat as work in progress and refuse to merge.

gitlab.note: The Draft: title prefix, which GitLab treats as a draft merge request.

capabilities.label: Checks for gates
capabilities.summary: A gate waits for the head commit's checks to pass.

forgejo.note: Commit statuses. Gitea and Forgejo Actions, Woodpecker and Drone all report through them.

gitea.note: Commit statuses. Gitea and Forgejo Actions, Woodpecker and Drone all report through them.

gitlab.note: Commit statuses, which every pipeline job reports.

capabilities.label: Merge readiness
capabilities.summary: The approve gate reads whether a pull request is clean, behind, conflicted or blocked.

forgejo.note: Worked out from mergeable, the reviews and the statuses. Branch protection is not read; the forge still enforces it on merge.

gitea.note: Worked out from mergeable, the reviews and the statuses. Branch protection is not read; the forge still enforces it on merge.

capabilities.label: Review decision
capabilities.summary: Whether a pull request is approved, needs a review or has changes requested.

forgejo.note: Worked out from each reviewer's latest review; stale and dismissed reviews do not count.

gitea.note: Worked out from each reviewer's latest review; stale and dismissed reviews do not count.

gitlab.note: Read from the merge request's approvals; a requested change is a note, not a state.

capabilities.label: Submit reviews
capabilities.summary: pr_review nodes approve, comment on or request changes to a pull request, with inline comments.

gitlab.note: APPROVE is an approval, COMMENT a note, REQUEST_CHANGES a note with this account's approval withdrawn; inline comments are diff discussions.

capabilities.label: Request a team's review
capabilities.summary: A checkpoint can ask a team to review.

gitlab.note: GitLab reviewers are users; name the people instead.

capabilities.label: Update branch
capabilities.summary: A checkpoint brings a pull request's branch up to date with its base.

forgejo.note: A merge of the base into the head (pulls/{n}/update?style=merge).

gitea.note: A merge of the base into the head (pulls/{n}/update?style=merge).

gitlab.note: A rebase of the merge request (merge_requests/{iid}/rebase).

capabilities.label: Server-signed commits
capabilities.summary: Commits the factory writes (conflict resolution, curator ships) are signed with the tenant's KMS key.

forgejo.note: The signed commit is built by the factory and pushed over git; the forge shows it verified when the key is on the signer's account.

gitea.note: The signed commit is built by the factory and pushed over git; the forge shows it verified when the key is on the signer's account.

gitlab.note: The signed commit is built by the factory and pushed over git; GitLab shows it verified when the key is on the signer's account.

capabilities.label: Issue and label sync
capabilities.summary: Board cards mirror to issues both ways, with sf: and belai: labels.

forgejo.note: Labels are written by id; a missing label is created first.

gitea.note: Labels are written by id; a missing label is created first.

capabilities.label: Close reason
capabilities.summary: An issue closed as not planned is told apart from one closed as completed.

forgejo.note: Gitea and Forgejo issues have no close reason; the card records it on the board only.

gitea.note: Gitea and Forgejo issues have no close reason; the card records it on the board only.

gitlab.note: GitLab issues have no close reason; the card records it on the board only.

capabilities.label: Rate-limit budget
capabilities.summary: The quota guard shares the forge's call budget between the factory and everything else.

forgejo.note: Gitea and Forgejo send no rate-limit headers; the guard counts calls against forge.calls_per_hour.

gitea.note: Gitea and Forgejo send no rate-limit headers; the guard counts calls against forge.calls_per_hour.

capabilities.label: Bot attribution
capabilities.summary: What the factory does is attributed to a bot identity, not a person.

forgejo.note: The connection's bot account.

gitea.note: The connection's bot account.

gitlab.note: The connection's bot user or access-token user.

capabilities.label: Forge security alerts
capabilities.summary: Dependabot, code scanning and secret scanning alerts become findings.

forgejo.note: Gitea and Forgejo publish no security alerts; Vulnetix's own scanners fill the gap.

gitea.note: Gitea and Forgejo publish no security alerts; Vulnetix's own scanners fill the gap.

gitlab.note: GitLab's security reports are pipeline artifacts, not alerts; Vulnetix's own scanners fill the gap.

capabilities.label: Merge queue
capabilities.summary: merge_group events and readiness in a merge queue.

forgejo.note: Gitea and Forgejo have no merge queue.

gitea.note: Gitea and Forgejo have no merge queue.

gitlab.note: GitLab merge trains are not read.

capabilities.label: App capability catalogue
capabilities.summary: The GitHub App capabilities (posture, identity, audit log and the rest).

forgejo.note: These read GitHub-only APIs.

gitea.note: These read GitHub-only APIs.

gitlab.note: These read GitHub-only APIs.

capabilities.label: Belai clone and publish
capabilities.summary: Belai hosts clone, push and open pull requests with the connection's token.

capabilities.label: Manifest curator
capabilities.summary: The manifest curator reads a repository's manifests and opens its fix pull requests.

forgejo.note: The manifest curator works through the Vulnetix GitHub App on github.com. The factory's own workflows fix dependencies on every forge.

ghes.note: The manifest curator works through the Vulnetix GitHub App on github.com. The factory's own workflows fix dependencies on every forge.

gitea.note: The manifest curator works through the Vulnetix GitHub App on github.com. The factory's own workflows fix dependencies on every forge.

gitlab.note: The manifest curator works through the Vulnetix GitHub App on github.com. The factory's own workflows fix dependencies on every forge.

capabilities.label: Pix Sandbox repositories
capabilities.summary: A Pix Sandbox attaches a repository, clones it and opens pull requests from it.

forgejo.note: A Pix Sandbox reaches repositories through the Vulnetix GitHub App on github.com. Belai on your own machines works on every forge.

ghes.note: A Pix Sandbox reaches repositories through the Vulnetix GitHub App on github.com. Belai on your own machines works on every forge.

gitea.note: A Pix Sandbox reaches repositories through the Vulnetix GitHub App on github.com. Belai on your own machines works on every forge.

gitlab.note: A Pix Sandbox reaches repositories through the Vulnetix GitHub App on github.com. Belai on your own machines works on every forge.

gitea.note: From a commit status (the status event): completed when the status is final. Gitea 1.22 has no status event and keeps a webhook without it, so check_run triggers do not fire there; gates still read the statuses.
